spec.name: Neon Horizon — 1980s Arcade Cabinet
spec.description: A 1980s upright arcade cabinet rendered in synthwave: a black-and-purple shell with chrome trim, a glowing sunset marquee, a CRT alive with a neon grid and striped sun, and a deck of glowing buttons and a magenta ball-top joystick.
spec.layout: Classic upright arcade silhouette facing +Z, about 0.72 m wide, 1.8 m tall, 0.87 m deep, standing flat on the floor. From front to back: a protruding control deck (y 0.86–1.02, reaching forward to z 0.42) with a slanted top carrying a joystick on the left and two clusters of six buttons either side; below it the lower cabinet's front slants back down to a chrome kick plate that rests on y = 0. The middle holds the screen recess: the cabinet front face leans back about 12° and the CRT sits inside it, glass facing up-forward, surrounded by a black bezel with chrome edge. Above the screen, the cabinet top sweeps back and the marquee header (y 1.5–1.8) tilts forward over the player, showing a glowing title sign over sunset stripes, with two backlit speaker grilles below it. The sides are tall flat panels with the classic swooping arcade profile, edged with chrome T-molding and a thin cyan neon tube tracing the silhouette; the back panel is plain dark with a vent grille. The cabinet splits at y = 0.9 (a horizontal neon trim seam), so the shell and base build matching side-panel profiles that read as one piece. Style on every part: flat black/purple faces, chrome fittings, and self-lit neon — cyan grid, magenta horizon, sunset sun on the screen, glowing marquee letters, backlit speaker slits, lit coin slots, a magenta ball top, and a cyan underglow line where the cabinet meets the floor.

parts.builds: The upper cabinet (y 0.9–1.8) and marquee. Two tall side panels in cabinetBlack with a cabinetPurple inner face, drawn with the classic arcade profile (steep front under the screen, deep top, short tail at the back), built as extruded slabs; their outer edges carry chrome T-molding strips and a thin neonCyan tube swept along the silhouette edge. A top panel and plain back panel (cordBlack) with a small steel vent grille close the box; the shell's lower front face spans the deck ledge at deckRoot. The screen recess is a lean-back opening framed with a black bezel lip that meets the screen assembly around screenWell (the recess opening is the shell's job). Above it, the marquee header tilts forward: a cabinetPurple frame holding a glowing sign panel — a dark glass slab with sunsetGold, sunsetOrange and sunsetPink horizontal stripe bands behind, and the title 'NEON RIDER' built as thin extruded neon tube letters, N-E-O-N in neonCyan and RIDER in neonMagenta, all glowing. Below the marquee, two recessed speaker panels in cabinetBlack with rows of horizontal slot slits, glowWhite backing parts glowing through the gaps. A chrome trim band runs around the marquee frame.
parts.attaches: Sits on the base at the waistSeam mount (matching side profiles, a neonMagenta trim seam at y 0.9 built by both), frames the screen recess around screenWell, and offers the deck ledge at deckRoot.

parts.builds: The CRT assembly seated in the shell's recess at screenWell, glass tilted back about 12° facing up and forward. A screenDeep glass slab with a chrome bezel frame (cabinetBlack outer, chrome inner edge, small steel corner screws) and a thin neonViolet accent line around the glass. The glass carries the synthwave scene built from thin flat parts laid on its surface: a big low sun made of stacked sunsetGold, sunsetOrange and sunsetPink horizontal bands with dark scanline gaps between them; a glowing neonMagenta horizon line across the middle; below it a perspective grid of neonCyan lines — long converging rails fanning from the horizon down the glass plus several horizontal rungs growing wider toward the viewer, all thin glow strips; and a few tiny glowWhite star dots in the upper sky. Under the glass on the bezel's lower ledge: a small chrome brand plate and a single glowing neonCyan power LED dot, plus a cordBlack cable stub dropping from the lower back corner.
parts.attaches: Fills the shell's screen recess around the screenWell mount; its bezel lip meets the shell's recess frame.

parts.builds: The control deck: a slanted panel (rising ~8° toward the player) in deckDark with a chrome edge trim around its perimeter and a neonCyan glow strip along the forward lip. Two mirrored player stations. Left station: a joystick — a steel dust-washer disc, a chrome shaft leaning slightly to the right, and a big glossy neonMagenta ball top, all glowing slightly at the ball. Right station: two rows of three pushbuttons (buttonWhite, buttonRed, sunsetGold caps) each seated in a dark bezel ring with a chrome rim; the centre bottom button of the inner row on each side. Between the stations a start panel: a small cabinetBlack recess with two small round start buttons in neonCyan and neonMagenta, both glowing, above a tiny glowWhite 'CREDIT 1' strip decal and a glowing neonViolet coin-credit counter slit. Deck underside is cordBlack with a steel support bracket angling back to the cabinet body.
parts.attaches: Rear edge laps onto the cabinet front at the deckRoot mount; its underside sits over the base's upper front.

parts.builds: The lower cabinet (y 0–0.9): side panels in cabinetBlack with cabinetPurple inner faces continuing the shell's profile exactly to meet at the waistSeam, with chrome T-molding and a continuing neonCyan edge tube; a horizontal neonMagenta trim line at the very seam. The front face slants back from the deck underside down to a recessed kick zone; on it sits a coin door — a chrome-framed dark panel with two coin slots stacked vertically (cordBlack slots with glowing neonCyan rims, coinGold coin-return buttons) and a small glowing 'INSERT COIN' strip in neonMagenta. The kick plate at the bottom is brushed chrome with a row of cabinetPurple vent slots. A thin neonCyan underglow strip runs around the cabinet's foot line just above y = 0, glowing onto the floor. The back lower panel carries a steel vent grille and a small glowing neonViolet exhaust strip. Small dark levelling feet sit at the four corners, the cabinet's lowest points touching y = 0.
parts.attaches: Carries the shell at the waistSeam mount (matching side profiles), offers the flat top region under the deck, and the front face meets the deck's underside at deckRoot; its kick plate and feet rest on y = 0.
